feature_name: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
value_label: Shelters or safe houses are run at some missions by policy or practice
note: Missions run shelters for citizens in distress as part of citizen protection; no statutory duty to maintain them was found in Law 18/2017.
source: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, citizen protection; Law 18/2017

value_label: An official line exists but not around the clock, or only at some missions
note: KP2MI runs a crisis center and complaint channels; round-the-clock operation is not confirmed.

value_label: A statute provides or funds legal assistance for workers abroad, including in criminal and civil proceedings
note: Protection during work includes legal assistance and advocacy by the government and missions.

value_label: Gender-specific measures rest on policy or programs
note: The 2017 Law states general principles of non-discrimination and gender equality; services for women survivors rest on programs with the women's empowerment ministry.

value_label: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
note: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan pays death benefits and the government repatriates remains; no procedure for an independent examination of the cause of death was found.

value_label: A dedicated statute criminalizes trafficking for forced labor and provides victim assistance, protection or restitution
note: Law 21/2007 criminalizes trafficking for exploitation including forced labor, with restitution and witness and victim protection.

feature_name: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
value_label: A statute requires shelters or resource centers with temporary accommodation at missions in destination countries
note: Migrant Workers and Other Overseas Filipinos Resource Centers at missions provide counseling, legal services and temporary shelter.

value_label: An official assistance line or crisis center for workers abroad operates 24 hours
note: The Department of Migrant Workers and OWWA operate a 24-hour operations center and hotlines.

value_label: A statute provides or funds legal assistance for workers abroad, including in criminal and civil proceedings
note: A Legal Assistance Fund and a Legal Assistant for Migrant Workers' Affairs provide legal services to workers abroad.

value_label: Statute contains specific duties on violence against women migrant workers (for example gender-responsive services or officers)
note: The law requires gender-sensitive programs and services for women migrant workers; the Magna Carta of Women adds duties for women overseas.

value_label: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
note: Repatriation of remains is at the agency's cost and OWWA pays death benefits; autopsies are available on the family's request through the National Bureau of Investigation, but no statutory inquiry procedure was found.

value_label: A dedicated statute criminalizes trafficking for forced labor and provides victim assistance, protection or restitution
note: Comprehensive anti-trafficking law with victim protection, assistance and a council; amended in 2012 and 2022.
source: RA 9208 as amended by RA 10364 and RA 11862

feature_name: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
value_label: No shelters documented
note: No dedicated shelters at missions were documented; labor management sections assist workers.

value_label: An official line exists but not around the clock, or only at some missions
note: The Department of Overseas Labor and missions operate hotlines; round-the-clock operation is not confirmed.

value_label: A statute provides or funds legal assistance for workers abroad, including in criminal and civil proceedings
note: The Overseas Employment Support Fund can fund legal support for workers abroad.

value_label: Gender-specific measures rest on policy or programs
note: The Law applies a general principle of gender equality; no specific duty on violence against women migrant workers was found.

value_label: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
note: The Support Fund pays death support and repatriation costs; no independent examination route was found.

value_label: A dedicated statute criminalizes trafficking for forced labor and provides victim assistance, protection or restitution
note: A dedicated Law on Human Trafficking Prevention and Combat (2011) with victim support; a new law adopted in 2024 replaces it (in force 2025, to be confirmed).
source: Law 66/2011/QH12; Law on Prevention and Combat of Human Trafficking 2024

feature_name: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
value_label: Shelters or safe houses are run at some missions by policy or practice
note: Safe houses are run at some missions with support from the Foreign Employment Welfare Fund.

value_label: An official line exists but not around the clock, or only at some missions
note: The Department of Foreign Employment and the Foreign Employment Board run helplines; round-the-clock operation is not confirmed.

value_label: Legal assistance is funded by policy or discretionary funds
note: The Welfare Fund and missions provide assistance, but no statutory legal aid for proceedings abroad was found.

value_label: Gender-specific measures rest on policy or programs
note: The Foreign Employment Policy 2012 has a section on women workers; the Act has no specific provision on violence.

value_label: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
note: The Welfare Fund pays compensation to families and repatriates remains; causes of death are rarely examined after return.

value_label: A dedicated statute criminalizes trafficking for forced labor and provides victim assistance, protection or restitution
note: Dedicated Act criminalizes trafficking and transportation, with rehabilitation and compensation for victims.

note: Dedicated Act with special tribunals and victim protection and rehabilitation.
